Converted both gravel wheels to tubeless with the user.

- Taped each rim twice and fitted new valves.
- Seated the tyres with a booster pump; the rear needed soapy water.
- Added 60 ml of sealant per tyre.
- Decided on 2.1 bar front and 2.3 bar rear for mixed gravel.
